reason: In app/assets/stylesheets/desktop/topic-post.scss:291, `.embedded-posts .topic-meta-data h5 a` sets `color: dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 30%))`. Because `dark-light-choose` (app/assets/stylesheets/common/foundation/variables.scss:46-52) returns the first argument on light themes and the second on dark themes, the swapped 70%/30% values make the bold link much lighter and lower-contrast than intended (unlike the matching 30%/70% in app/assets/stylesheets/common/base/topic-post.scss:14).
